Plot bootstrap intervals of pathway informativeness

Source: R/bootstrap.R
plot.transitiontrees_bootstrap.Rd

plot() draws a forest plot of each pathway's likelihood-ratio statistic \(G^2\) against its parent context: the bootstrap mean with its percentile interval, one row per pathway, colored and ordered by whether the pathway is stable, informative, both or neither. A dashed line marks the chi-square critical value used by the bootstrap; a pathway whose interval lies wholly to its right departs reproducibly from its shorter history.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees_bootstrap'
plot(x, top = 25L, min_stability = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A transitiontrees_bootstrap object.

top

Maximum number of pathways shown. Default 25.

min_stability

Smallest stability_rate shown. Default NULL: the stability_threshold of the bootstrap.

...

Ignored.

Value

A ggplot object: one row per pathway with the mean \(G^2\) and its interval.

Conditions

transitiontrees_empty_result

(error) no pathway with a \(G^2\) reaches min_stability.

See also

bootstrap_pathways(), plot_pathway_resamples() for the resample distributions.

Examples

boot <- bootstrap_pathways(context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 2),
                           iter = 50)
plot(boot, min_stability = 0.5)
